evidence: The rapid evolution and increased adoption of artificial intelligence technologies, by us or by third parties, may also heighten our cybersecurity risks by making cyberattacks more difficult to prevent, detect, contain and mitigate.

Any failure to maintain proper function, security and availability of our information systems and those of our information technology vendors could interrupt our operations, damage our reputation, or subject us to liability claims or regulatory penalties
ai_positioning.summary: RYN adopte une posture défensive face à l'IA, en mettant l'accent sur les risques cybersécurité accrus liés à l'adoption croissante des technologies d'IA sans mentionner d'initiatives propres d'intégration ou de développement.
